frames.title: Pickaxe ready
frames.description: Front-right, mining beside an isolated low rock fragment, both hands hold pickaxe high over shoulder in a balanced ready stance. Stocky woman with copper braids, helmet, teal tunic, leather apron, NO beard.

frames.title: Pickaxe contact
frames.description: Same camera and rock fragment, pickaxe lowered so tip touches stone at end of strike, feet remain planted, complete pickaxe and both hands visible.

frames.title: Inspect mineral
frames.description: Left-side, kneeling at a low wooden mineral sorting table examining a small ore sample with a magnifying lens, helmet still on.

frames.title: Shovel stone
frames.description: Front-left, shoveling loose stone from a small pile into a wooden bucket, weight shifted onto front foot.

frames.title: Carry mine timber
frames.description: Rear-right, carrying a short stout timber support on one shoulder with two hands steadying it, entire timber and boots visible.

frames.title: Bind tool handle
frames.description: Front-right, behind a low repair bench binding a replacement pickaxe handle with a leather strap, tool head and small hammer on bench.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
